description: This Java class 'ParameterBody' models HTTP request parameters, providing methods for creation, string representation, equality, and hashing, within the mockserver project.

classes.name: ParameterBody
classes.description: Represents a body containing URL-encoded parameters for HTTP requests, with methods for creation, string conversion, and equality checks.

methods.name: params
methods.description: Factory methods to create ParameterBody instances with different parameter inputs.

methods.name: parameterBody
methods.description: Alternative factory methods for creating ParameterBody instances.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the Parameters object contained in this ParameterBody.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts the ParameterBody to a URL-encoded string representation.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on parameters and superclass.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on superclass and parameters.
